records.symptom: Motion validation failed because independently rendered image pixels were treated as pose identity after otherwise successful task validation.
records.root_cause: Rendered-image equality is not a stable invariant for animation pose; lighting/AA/render initialization can differ while final skeleton transforms remain equivalent.
records.causal_repair: Compare final Skeleton3D transforms/contact state after controlled warm-up; preserve frame hashes only for provenance.
protected_files: approved upstream animation clips unless transform evidence disproves them
proof: pixel equality/RMSE is rejected as a pose gate
records.prevention_rule: Motion gates use pose/contact space for motion identity and image hashes only for provenance.

records.symptom: A supposedly fixed t=0 pose drifted substantially during settle frames.
records.root_cause: The capture harness sought t=0 while leaving AnimationPlayer running, so real-time settle frames advanced the clip and invalidated the explicit sample.
records.causal_repair: Freeze animation clock during sampled-pose settling while still allowing SkeletonModifier convergence.
records.prevention_rule: Sampled-pose harnesses separate animation time from modifier convergence time.

records.symptom: A task candidate was rejected because newly added governance/control-plane files were not included in QA-GOV ownership.
records.root_cause: Governance ownership metadata lagged behind the control-plane file set.
records.causal_repair: Add the control-plane files to @ownership:QA-GOV and reproduce integration-scope validation without changing task runtime.
records.prevention_rule: Every new control-plane authority is governance-owned in the same architecture change set.

records.symptom: A task workflow resolved the reusable C0 workflow but failed before creating jobs.
records.root_cause: Reusable workflows cannot elevate GITHUB_TOKEN permissions above the caller; the caller omitted actions: read required to retrieve failed-run evidence.
records.causal_repair: Grant the minimal read-only actions permission at the caller and enforce the caller permission contract in source validation.
records.prevention_rule: Reusable workflow caller permissions are validated statically before task CI is considered ready.
